content: संशप्तकः [सम्यक् शप्तमङ्गीकारो यस्य कप् <ls>Tv.</ls>] .²1 A warrior sworn never to recede from a contest and kept to prevent the flight of others; संशप्तकान्निहतानर्जुनेन तदा नाशंसे विजयाय संजय <ls>Mb. 1. 1. 189</ls>. .²2 A picked warrior. .²3 A brother in arms. .²4 A conspirator who has taken an oath to kill another.
